json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.meta.author: Outfit Distributor
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.meta.note: Community translators: copy this file, change meta.language/meta.code/meta.author, and translate only the values in strings. Keep placeholders such as %s, %d, %zu, %.0f%% and {} unchanged.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.common.help.load_cached: Load the list when needed. It remains cached for this session.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.common.search_forms: Search name, EditorID, plugin or reference...
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.diagnostics.0de587387bba: Mode: Dual Wield | Primary -> Right | Off-hand -> Left
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.diagnostics.2570777ba541: Select an NPC and press Inspect / refresh.

json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.diagnostics.2b606b6e557c: Scan NPCs currently loaded in 3D and measure which rules match, win, or are shadowed. The scan is read-only and never changes outfits, rules, or cosave data.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.diagnostics.2f9064b0f659: Each entry rolls independently. Dependencies and occupied slots can prevent a selected candidate from being equipped.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.diagnostics.32c1b5ceac3d: No loaded actor matches this rule in the current snapshot.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.diagnostics.46547f9e9f72: Shadowed means another base-outfit rule wins according to current runtime priority. Sleep, additive and weapon matches remain independent where applicable.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.diagnostics.56637fe78bfe: This is a snapshot. Run the scan again after moving cells, reloading rules, or changing NPC state.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.diagnostics.5caeb8a358f0: Ammo applied: %s | Added by OD this assignment: %u
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.diagnostics.65baf22f6d1f: No rule was evaluated for this actor.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.diagnostics.6a7dfe10a8cd: Click ? for help about this page.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.diagnostics.6cc195f3e728: Competing loadout replaced: %s | Displaced weapons: %zu | Displaced shields: %zu
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.diagnostics.78c80a845430: Shield added by OD: %s | Applied: %s | Equipped now: %s

json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.diagnostics.b5d5e13a7dd7: Added by OD: %s | Initial equip done: %s | Equipped now: %s
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.diagnostics.bd09f7d654f7: Rules with at least one match: %zu / %zu
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.diagnostics.c0ad5e9eef2f: Optional integrations detected at runtime. All are soft dependencies; the plugin runs without them.

json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.extensions.ambiguous: Duplicate Rule ID: receiver is ambiguous.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.extensions.choose: Choose a Rule ID or type one above
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.extensions.create_help: Adds weighted outfits to an existing Rule ID. Parent targets and conditions remain unchanged.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.extensions.help: Only the parent outfit pool is extended. Targets, conditions, exclusions and other outputs belong to the parent. Missing or ambiguous IDs produce warnings instead of preventing OD from loading.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.extensions.id_help: Optional stable, case-sensitive ID, for example xRevanchiste.Citizens. Other files can extend this rule without changing its targets or conditions. An empty outfit receiver remains inactive until an extension provides outfits.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.extensions.invalid_id: Enter a valid target Rule ID.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.extensions.missing: Receiver missing/unresolved. The ID is preserved; the extension can be shared before its parent is installed.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.extensions.no_outfits: Select at least one weighted outfit.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.extensions.subtitle: Choose a receiver and add weighted outfits
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.extensions.title: Rule Extension
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.inspector.intro: Inspect loaded files, optional dependencies and rule coverage, or select a loaded NPC to examine its outfit and equipment state.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.inspector.no_npc_target: No NPC was found at that target.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.inspector.player_not_managed: The Player is not managed by Outfit Distributor.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.inspector.reapply_failed: Reapply could not start. The NPC is not ready or no outfit is available to reapply.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.inspector.reapply_help: Keeps the outfit currently chosen by OD and forces a real reapplication for this NPC only. Useful for LVLI-based outfits or an NPC that is assigned correctly but visually unequipped. It does not call resetinventory.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.inspector.reapply_queued: Reapply queued through OD's normal outfit pipeline.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.inspector.reroll_help: Clears this NPC's current OD selection and rerolls only among outfits in the active OD pool. The rule's vanillaChance is ignored for this manual reroll. Persistent outfit/accessory choices and LVLI results are rerolled too.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.inspector.reroll_requested: Reroll requested. OD will reroll from this NPC's active outfit pool and reroll accessories.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.inspector.restore_confirm: Restore %s to the original outfit state saved by Outfit Distributor?
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.inspector.restore_pending: Vanilla restore is pending. OD will retry when this NPC is safe to modify.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.inspector.restore_queued: Vanilla restore queued; OD will retry when this NPC is loaded, awake and safe to modify.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.inspector.restore_vanilla_help: Releases OD-managed outfit, accessories, weapons, sleep outfit metadata and persistent choices for this NPC, then restores the original outfit saved before OD changed it. No resetinventory is used. If active OD rules still match this NPC later, OD can manage it again.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.inspector.restore_warning: OD-managed equipment will be released. The NPC's full inventory will NOT be reset.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.inspector.target_console_help: Select an NPC in the Skyrim console first, close the console, then use this button.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.inspector.target_crosshair_help: Selects the NPC currently under the crosshair. The Player is intentionally ignored.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.inspector.title: DIAGNOSTICS
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.localization.community_hint: To add a translation, copy en.json, change the meta block and translate the string values. The new language appears automatically after Reload translations.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.localization.help: English is always the fallback. Community translations placed in Data/SKSE/Plugins/OutfitDist/Localization are detected automatically and do not require a DLL rebuild.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.localization.subtitle: Choose the Native UI language
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.localization.title: Localization
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.native.dedicated_view: This page is handled by its dedicated Native UI view.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.native.header.subtitle: Native UI 0.2  /  Rules, outfits and diagnostics
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.setup.escape_resize: Escape closes it. Drag the lower-right corner to resize.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.setup.game_continues: The game continues while this window is open.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.setup.hotkey_capture_help: Press any keyboard key now. Escape cancels. The new shortcut is saved immediately.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.setup.hotkey_help: Choose the keyboard shortcut used to open or close the Native UI. F8 is the default.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.setup.intro: Native UI controls and maintenance tools for Outfit Distributor.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.setup.loaded_files_hint: Diagnostics from the last runtime config load. Refresh reads this snapshot; it does not reload or validate files.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.setup.maintenance_help: Use this before removing outfit packs or when cleaning a save. OD restores only state it manages; it never calls resetinventory.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.setup.mouse_keyboard: Mouse and keyboard navigation are available.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.setup.no_loaded_files: No file diagnostics available from the last load.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.setup.restore_all_body: This restores saved original outfits and releases OD-managed accessories, weapons, sleep metadata and persistent selections. Unloaded NPCs are queued for their next safe load.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.setup.restore_all_confirm: Release Outfit Distributor state from all %zu tracked NPC(s)?
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.setup.restore_all_help: Restores the saved original outfit state for every NPC OD has actually modified. Loaded NPCs are restored immediately when safe; unloaded/sleeping NPCs are queued and restored on a later load. The queue and managed-NPC registry are saved in the SKSE cosave, so cleanup can continue after save/reload. Remove or disable unwanted rules/packs first if you do not want OD to manage those NPCs again later.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.setup.restore_all_status: Restore all requested: %zu tracked, %zu restored now, %zu queued for later.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.setup.restore_all_warning: This does NOT reset NPC inventories. Remove/disable unwanted OD rules or outfit packs first if this is a cleanup operation.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.setup.title: SETUP
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.setup.window_controls_help: These settings describe the Native UI itself; they do not alter outfit distribution rules.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.accessories.help: Accessories are independent entries such as hoods, cloaks, wigs, backpacks, masks or jewelry. Add only the entries you need; advanced dependency and persistence settings stay out of the way until opened.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.accessories.subtitle: Optional additive items worn over the selected outfit.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.accessories.title: Accessories
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.accessory_id_help: Optional name for this accessory entry. Give it an ID only when another accessory needs to depend on it.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.accessory_mode_help: Explicit items builds a weighted pool from specific ARMO/LVLI records. Plugin + slot builds a pool from playable armor in one plugin that uses the chosen biped slot.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.accessory_rotation_help: The main outfit stays fixed. This value still controls normal accessory rotation timing.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.add_accessory_help: Creates one independent accessory entry with its own chance and item pool.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.ammunition_help: Select arrows or bolts for Single Weapon rules. OD picks one compatible AMMO entry once per NPC and ensures the NPC owns at least the configured quantity.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.armor_list_help: Loads playable ARMO records so Outfit Distributor can build the plugin + biped-slot pool. The list stays cached for the current session.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.biped_slot_help: Skyrim biped slots identify equipment areas. Valid slots are 30-61. Modded equipment may use the higher slots differently by convention, and one armor record can occupy several slots at once.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.build_json_preview_help: Builds the exact rule JSON through the existing Rule Wizard backend without writing a file.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.cell_help: Use Cell for a very specific interior or exterior cell. Only the NPC's exact current parent cell matches; this is narrower than Location.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.chance_to_distribute_help: Rolled once per NPC and persisted in the OD cosave. If the roll fails, OD remembers that result instead of rerolling on every refresh.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.chance_to_equip_help: 100% always attempts to use this accessory entry; 0% never equips it.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.climate_help_full: Cold climate uses Outfit Distributor's native region/weather analysis. Exterior regions count as cold when snow-classified weather has enough weight. Interior cells do not match the cold-climate condition.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.climate_help_short: Cold climate uses Outfit Distributor's native region/weather analysis. Interior cells do not match the cold-climate condition.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.conditions.help: Conditions are optional filters evaluated in game. Combine them only when you want a rule to apply in a specific place, climate, weather, season or time window.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.conditions.subtitle: Choose where and when this rule can run. Leave everything empty for no restriction.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.conditions.title: Conditions
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.current_outfit_help: Targets the original outfit memorized before OD replacement (JSON: currentOutfit). If SkyPatcher, SPID or another mod changed it before the first OD snapshot, that initial runtime outfit is memorized.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.current_outfit_hint: Match the original outfit memorized by OD before replacement.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.delete_json_help: This removes '%s' and every rule stored in it. Outfit Distributor creates a .bak backup first, reloads its configurations and refreshes affected loaded actors.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.delete_rule_help: This removes the selected rule from '%s'. Other rules and file settings are preserved. A .bak backup is created first; if this is the last rule, the JSON file is kept with an empty rules array.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.detailed_selections_hint: Open this only when you want to verify the exact forms selected in each section.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.distribution_settings_hin: Optional controls for persistence, rotation, chance and conflict handling.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.dual_wield_help: Dual Wield supports one-handed swords, daggers, war axes, maces and staffs. The backend validator rejects incompatible weapon types before saving.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.dynamic_weapon_condition_: Dynamic Weapon Rules are reevaluated when OD refreshes the NPC. Leaving their conditions restores displaced equipment before switching to another Weapon Rule.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.edit_intro: Choose a JSON file and a rule in the Source / Edit panel on the left, then load it. The Native UI will import all supported fields and keep unknown JSON fields through the existing Rule Wizard backend.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.equipped_weapon_type_help: This is a condition, not weapon distribution. Leave every box unchecked to ignore equipped weapon type. It cannot be combined with a Weapon Rule output.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.equipped_weapon_type_hint: only match NPCs currently using these weapon types
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.exclude_location_keyword_: Use this as a negative location filter. Example: a backpack rule can run broadly but be blocked in locations tagged as cities or towns.
Prevent the rule from running in locations with selected keywords.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.exclusion_category_help: Choose what kind of record to exclude. Original Outfit excludes the outfit memorized by OD before replacement (JSON: excludeCurrentOutfit), including changes made by other mods before OD's first snapshot.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.exclusions.help: Exclusions always win over matching targets. Use them to protect specific NPCs or groups that should never receive this rule even when the other conditions match.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.exclusions.subtitle: Anything selected here is excluded from this rule.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.exclusions.title: Exclusions
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.existing_outfit_conflict_: Override lets this rule take control. Skip leaves an NPC already claimed by another OD rule unchanged.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.explicit_outfits_help: Use this when you know the exact outfit records you want in the pool. Multiple selected outfits give OD several possible choices.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.faction_rank_filters_help: Use this when faction membership alone is too broad. Multiple faction-rank filters use the All/Any match mode above.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.faction_rank_filters_hint: Require faction membership with an optional minimum and/or maximum rank.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.gender_help: Restricts the rule by the NPC's sex. 'Any' leaves gender unrestricted.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.hand_help: Only applies to Single Weapon. Auto lets Skyrim choose the compatible hand; Right or Left requests that specific hand.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.import_npc_help: Imports the currently targeted NPC as a persistent NPC target. Leveled/runtime actors are resolved to a stable base or template when possible.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.initial_equip_help: When enabled, OD requests initial equip and reasserts the loadout at combat start. Shield Only never forces an incompatible weapon out of a hand.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.interior_help: Choose whether the rule can match everywhere, only inside interior cells, or only outside.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.intro: Build the rule in 7 simple sections. Optional settings stay collapsed until you need them.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.is_unique_help: Unique NPCs are named or individually defined actors. 'Any' adds no restriction; 'Unique only' writes isUnique=true; 'Non-unique only' writes isUnique=false.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.item_pool_help: Weight 2 is twice as likely as weight 1. Several source plugins can be mixed in the same pool.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.item_pool_hint: ARMO and LVLI, with optional weights
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.keyword_rank_match_help: When several keyword or faction-rank filters are used, 'All' requires every filter to match. 'Any' allows a match when at least one does.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.loadout_mode_help: Single Weapon distributes one primary weapon and can also distribute ammunition. Dual Wield uses a primary right-hand pool plus an off-hand pool. Weapon + Shield uses a compatible one-handed primary weapon plus a shield. Shield Only preserves existing weapons and only manages the shield.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.location_help: Location uses the NPC's current BGSLocation. Selecting a broader location can also cover its child locations, making it useful for holds, towns or other location hierarchies.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.location_hint: Match a location and its nested child locations.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.location_keyword_help: Use location keywords for broad categories such as city, town or settlement instead of naming one specific location.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.location_keyword_hint: Require the current location to carry selected keywords.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.max_npcs_per_outfit_help: Limits how many NPCs may share the same distributed outfit. 0 means unlimited.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.maximum_level_help: Highest NPC level allowed to match this rule. 0 means no maximum level restriction.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.minimum_level_help: Lowest NPC level allowed to match this rule. 0 means no minimum level restriction.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.no_accessory: No accessory configured. This step is optional.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.optional_target_filters_h: Use these only when Targets alone are too broad.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.original_residents_help: Requires original placement OR a declared fixed AI assignment in the selected Cell, Worldspace and Location. Supports fixed posts, isolated/linked patrol markers, direct references, sandbox/sit/idle/sleep templates (including SleepAndGuard), and resolved reference aliases in running quests. Permanent guard posts without package conditions are supported, including their fixed Travel destination. Current-position filters still apply. Moving actors, follow/ordinary travel destinations, package-start/current positions and unresolved Location aliases are not residence evidence. Mod templates must inherit a recognized routine or use a supported package type. Sleep outfits and package execution are unchanged. Location keyword filters are unaffected.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.original_residents_requir: Select a Cell, Worldspace or Location for this option.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.outfit_formlists_help: Select a FormList that contains outfit references. This is useful when another mod already groups compatible outfits in a list.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.outfit_formlists_hint: Use a FLST as an outfit source.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.outfit_plugins_help: Adds an outfit source by plugin instead of selecting each OUTF record manually. Useful for outfit packs dedicated to distribution.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.outfit_plugins_hint: Use outfit records discovered from an entire plugin.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.outfits.help: This page defines the outfit pool produced by the rule. You may combine several source types; Outfit Distributor will keep their existing weighting and validation behavior when the JSON is built.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.outfits.subtitle: Choose the outfit pool. Start with Explicit outfits; the other sources are optional.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.outfits.title: Outfits
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.persistent_outfit_help: Pick one outfit per NPC and keep that choice across days and saves. Sleep outfits and accessories keep their own selection behavior.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.persistent_selection_help: Keeps the same valid accessory choice for this NPC across days, cell changes and save/reload.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.plugin_slot_help: Plugin + slot builds a random pool from playable armor records in this plugin that use the selected biped slot.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.rank_invalid: Minimum rank is higher than maximum rank.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.replace_duplicate_help: Replace and duplicate create a .bak backup and preserve file-level settings plus unknown rule fields.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.replace_restore_conflicts: Temporarily removes conflicting armor, equips the accessory, then restores the displaced armor when the accessory no longer applies. Useful for dynamic rain or snow accessories.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.requires_help: When set, this accessory is considered only if the accessory entry with that ID was selected first.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.review.help: The Rule Wizard backend validator runs before preview and before save. Editing preserves fields that the Native UI does not modify.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.review.subtitle: Check the complete rule, preview its JSON and choose how it should be saved.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.review.title: Review & Save
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.review_summary_line: Level %d-%d   |   Rotation %d day%s   |   Vanilla chance %d%%   |   Weather %s
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.rotation_days_help: Number of in-game days an outfit assignment is kept before a new roll is allowed. 1 allows daily rotation.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.rule_name_help: Human-readable name stored in the rule.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.runtime_conflict_help: Controls what OD does if another mod changes the NPC's default outfit later. Override takes control back; Respect keeps the external change.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.season_help: Runs the rule only during the selected seasons. If no season is selected, season does not restrict the rule.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.shield_only_pool_help: OD chooses one playable shield ARMO from this pool while preserving all existing weapons. If the hands are incompatible, the shield remains in inventory.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.shield_only_preserves: Shield Only preserves all existing weapons. No primary weapon pool is required.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.sleep_outfits_help: Sleep outfits are separate from the normal daytime outfit pool and are applied while the NPC is sleeping according to OD's native sleep-outfit behavior.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.sleep_outfits_hint: Optional outfits used by OD's sleep-outfit system.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.status.begin: Load installed forms to begin. Review the rule before saving.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.target_category_help: Choose a target record type, Original Outfit or Faction Rank. All shows the standard target records.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.targets.help: Select a target category, including Original Outfit or Faction Rank. Level, identity and equipped-weapon filters are always shown above the browser.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.targets.subtitle: Choose who can receive this rule; refine the match with the visible filters.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.targets.title: Targets
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.time_range_help: Restricts the rule to a daily time window. Overnight ranges are supported, for example 18:00 to 06:00.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.title: RULE WIZARD
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.validation_existing_json: Choose the existing JSON file that should receive this rule.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.validation_output: Select at least one outfit, sleep outfit, accessory or weapon output.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.validation_rank: A faction-rank minimum exceeds its maximum.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.validation_target: Add at least one target or matching condition.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.validation_time: Time start and end cannot be identical.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.validation_weapon_type: Remove Equipped Weapon Type conditions from Weapon Rules.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.validator_again: The backend validator runs again before any file is written.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.vanilla_outfit_chance_hel: 0% always uses this rule's outfit pool. Higher values allow some matching NPCs to keep their vanilla/default outfit.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.vanilla_outfit_chance_hin: chance to keep the original outfit
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.warning_dual_wield_offhan: Dual Wield requires at least one off-hand weapon.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.warning_weapon_type_condi: Equipped Weapon Type cannot be used as a condition on a Weapon Rule.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.weapon_shield_pool_help: OD chooses one playable shield ARMO from this pool and manages it together with the right-hand weapon.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.weapons.help: Weapon output is optional and can share a rule with outfits, sleep outfits and accessories. Weapon Rules support location, cell, location keywords, interior/exterior, time, climate, weather, season and level conditions. Displaced weapons and shields are restored before another Weapon Rule is applied, or when no Weapon Rule matches. Equipped Weapon Type conditions remain forbidden because the distributed weapon would change its own condition.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.weapons.subtitle: Optional weapon distribution: Single Weapon, Dual Wield, Weapon + Shield, or Shield Only.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.weapons.title: Weapon Rules
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.weather_help_full: Runs the rule only during the selected weather categories. Selecting several categories means any selected category may match. Useful for rain hoods, snow gear and similar dynamic accessories.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.weather_help_short: Runs the rule only during the selected weather categories. Selecting several categories means any selected category may match.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.workshop_outfits_help: Workshop entries can be combined in one pool. Weight 2 makes an entry twice as likely as weight 1, weight 3 three times as likely, and so on.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.workshop_outfits_hint: Use outfits created in Outfit Distributor's Workshop.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.worldspace_help: Choose WhiterunWorld for the city exterior or Tamriel for the surrounding landscape. Interior cells without a worldspace do not match. Parent worldspaces are not included.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.wizard.worldspace_hint: Match one exact worldspace, independently of Location.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.delete_help: Delete this outfit from its writable Outfit Pack. Confirmation is required.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.delete_read_only_help: This outfit belongs to a read-only installed pack and cannot be deleted here.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.duplicate_help: Create an independent copy. Read-only outfits are copied into your local writable Workshop pack.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.gallery_intro: List view is the default for better performance. In Gallery view, 3D thumbnails load only after you hover a card; ARMO slot summaries remain available as the fallback.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.meshes_not_detected: Meshes: not detected from resolved ARMO pieces
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.no_matches: No Workshop outfits match the current filters.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.no_matches_help: Create or import outfits with Workshop, or clear the search and pack filter.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.no_photo_override: No photo override. The 3D preview is used when available; the compact summary remains the fallback.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.pack_filter_help: Filter the Gallery by Workshop Outfit Pack. Read-only installed packs can be browsed but not deleted.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.photo_help: A real image is optional. When present it is shown below the 3D preview and can still be used as a static reference.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.photo_model_help: Auto prefers the female model when both male and female armor meshes are available.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.refresh_help: Reload Workshop Outfit Packs from disk.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.renderer_missing: Install/enable Mesh Rendering Framework 1.8 to use the 3D renderer. The Gallery still works without it.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.search_hint: Search outfit, ID, pack or piece...
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.select_to_inspect: Select an outfit in the Library to inspect it.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.set_photo_help: Choose an image only if you want a real visual thumbnail for this outfit.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.status.default: Library and Builder use the same WorkshopOutfits data.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.status.delete_failed: Workshop outfit could not be deleted.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.status.duplicate_failed: Could not duplicate the selected Workshop outfit.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.status.photo_folder_fai: Could not open the Outfit Distributor preview folder.
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.title: OUTFIT WORKSHOP
json:mod_interface_translation/outfit-di.strings.workshop.view_help: Switch between visual cards and a compact table.
